title: Understanding the Task
text: To determine the type of statistical problem, consider what the task is trying to achieve. Is it trying to predict, estimate, or determine a cause-and-effect relationship?

title: Identifying Causal Inference
text: Causal inference is used when you want to determine if one variable causes a change in another. Think about whether the task is trying to establish a cause-and-effect relationship.

title: Analyzing the Task
text: The task is investigating whether perceived gender affects student teaching evaluations. What kind of statistical problem does this represent?
